steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); })()

steps.name: boucle-sofa-and-sintered-worktop
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const items=s.items||[]; let sofa=0,wt=0; for(const it of items){ const d=(it.defId||'').toLowerCase(); if(/sofa|sectional|loveseat|armchair/.test(d)){ s.updateItemProps(it.id,{material:'boucle',color:'#cabfa9'}); sofa++; } if(/kitchen-counter|kitchen-island|counter/.test(d)){ s.updateItemProps(it.id,{worktopFinish:'sintered',worktopColor:'#e8e4dc'}); wt++; } } return 'sofa='+sofa+' worktop='+wt; })()
